answer: Give each funding graph a single terrace with one fixed reward pool, shared by every identity on it no matter how many spawn. To claim a share, an identity must first finish a solo voyage of sequential, non-parallelizable tasks, ending in an original sonnet that restates its own voyage log, so a copied sonnet is instantly exposed. Clones split the same pool while each pays the full voyage cost, so marginal profit shrinks with each extra identity and soon turns negative, while one honest agent keeps its whole terrace share.
